hero.title: Purpose-built for real workflows
hero.subtitle: AgentRuntime powers complex automations across GTM, support, operations, and product teams.

sections.title: Customer Support Automation
sections.summary: Blend LLM-powered resolutions with supervisor checkpoints and audit trails.
painPoints: Backlogs spike during product launches or incidents.
Traditional bots break when business logic changes.
Compliance teams need full visibility into agent decisions.
solutions: Route, summarize, and propose resolutions before humans step in.
Define guardrails + playbooks that update instantly.
Track every intervention with SOC2-ready audit logs.

sections.title: Sales Engineering Copilot
sections.summary: Generate architectures, demos, and RFx responses with traceable guardrails.
painPoints: SE teams spend hours crafting repetitive proposals.
Knowledge is fragmented across slides, wikis, and drive folders.
solutions: Automate architecture diagrams + narratives with customer-specific context.
Centralize knowledge and reuse winning patterns.
Route sensitive responses through legal/infosec supervisors.

sections.title: Operations + Back Office
sections.summary: Streamline reconciliation, onboarding, and incident coordination.
painPoints: Stakeholders rely on ad-hoc Slack/Email updates.
Auditors need consistent evidence for every run.
solutions: Codify approvals + SLA timers as reusable workflows.
Trigger human sign-off or reroute decisions instantly.
Generate audit packets automatically from every execution.
